A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PPC/PQA research. All 15 pages in each version, including Appendices A–E, are readable; text comparison and visual inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original PPC and PQA experiments in Section 4, including I2V model comparisons, training ablations, and RLHF results in Tables 1–3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original PPC and PQA experiments, quantitative results in Tables 1–3, and associated visual evaluations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 retain the same dataset-generation pipeline, I2V perspective recommendation, homography-based guidance, Flow-DPO alignment, and two-stage PQA model.

E1.justification: Both versions use GAIC, SACD, FLMS, FCDB, and Unsplash as data sources. The single-subject, multiple-subject, landscape, and UAV-like evaluation scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains CogVideoX 1.5 5B, Hunyuan I2V, and Wan2.1 14B. Changing 'Hunyuan i2v' to 'Hunyuan I2V' in its lower panel is capitalization only. The regression/BTT and RLHF comparisons also match.

E3.justification: The video-pair construction, training settings, data-ratio conditions, angle conditions, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendices C–E.

E4.justification: Both retain the same analyses of pairing counts, one-stage versus two-stage training, data ratios, transformation angles, RLHF, perspective consistency, and unstable outputs.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted findings, and visual examples match. For example, Table 1 reports Wan2.1 CMM of 0.5989 and FVD of 345 in both versions; Tables 2–3 also retain all values.

T1.justification: The RLHF objective, Flow-DPO mathematical development, and Bradley-Terry-with-ties probabilities and loss remain unchanged in Equations 1–6 and Appendix B.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty and contribution claims concerning perspective composition, automated dataset construction, video guidance, and PQA.

C2.justification: Interpretations of angle sensitivity, training-data instability, and RLHF benefits match. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning video duration, reconstruction quality, and unstable training.

D1.justification: Appendices A–E retain the same prompts, model configuration, LoRA details, learning rate, GPU budget, sampling instructions, and grading rules. The project-page link and other access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 64 numbered references match in substance. Positioning relative to cropping, outpainting, and human-preference evaluation is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 removes the East China University of Science and Technology affiliation and numbered affiliation markers, leaving vivo. It also updates the version stamp and capitalizes 'Hunyuan I2V' consistently in Table 1. The prose and section organization otherwise match.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11 and Tables 1–5 retain their graphics, structure, captions, and placement, including the appendix tables. The author-text and capitalization edits introduce no structural layout change.

improvement.justification: The affiliation update and baseline-name capitalization are limited editorial changes. The methods, empirical evidence, mathematical content, appendix documentation, and limitations remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
